fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
Adversaries may search the Registry on compromised systems for insecurely stored credentials.
The Windows Registry stores configuration information that can be used by the system or other programs.
Adversaries may query the Registry looking for credentials and passwords that have been stored for use by other programs or services
fields.name: Enumeration for Credentials in Registry
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\reg.exe" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains " query " and tgt.process.cmdline contains "/t " and tgt.process.cmdline contains "REG_SZ" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "/s")) and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "/f " and tgt.process.cmdline contains "HKLM") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "/f " and tgt.process.cmdline contains "HKCU") or tgt.process.cmdline contains "HKCU\\Software\\SimonTatham\\PuTTY\\Sessions")))
